item.title: GhostCue 2.0.1
item.description:
• Introducing the Live Rail — GhostCue listens to your call and suggests the right section as its topic comes up. Click a suggestion to jump straight there.
  • It runs entirely on your Mac: nothing is recorded, nothing ever leaves your device.
  • Arm it with the wand button on the cue card, then drag the rail anywhere you like (Apple Silicon).
  • Cue cards now lock while you present — double-click the text or use the pencil button to edit.
  • ⌘[ and ⌘] switch cue cards from any app, and ⌘' hide/unhide now works in Cue Mode.
  • Reworked Bluetooth headphone support — no more mic connect/disconnect loops.
  • 2.0.1 — Denied a permission by mistake? GhostCue now takes you straight to the right setting instead of leaving you stuck.
